question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Social Harmony’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Narendra Modi's book 'Social Harmony'** is a collection of writings on Dalits, Tribals, Women, and Family Relations that explains how to attain Social Harmony in our society.
 
• The title of the book in Hindi is "Samajik Samrasta." Narendra Modi has written numerous books.
 
• Exam warriors, Jyotipunj, Convenient Action: Continuity for Change, and others are some of the most popular novels. 
 
• **Narendra Damodardas Modi **is an Indian politician who has been the country's 14th and current Prime Minister since 2014.
 
• He is a Member of Parliament from Varanasi and was the Chief Minister of Gujarat from 2001 until 2014.
 
• He is the first prime minister to be born after India's independence in 1947, and the second prime minister to win two consecutive majorities in the Lok Sabha, or lower house of India's parliament, who is not a member of the Indian National Congress.
 
• He is also the longest-serving prime minister from a party other than the Democratic Party.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **H.D Deve Gowda** is a politician in the Indian state of Karnataka. From June 1, 1996, to April 21, 1997, he was India's 11th Prime Minister.
 
• **Manmohan Singh** is an economist and statesman who served as India's 13th Prime Minister from 2004 to 2014.
 
• **Pamulaparthi Venkata Narasimha Rao**, an Indian lawyer, and politician, was the country's ninth Prime Minister from 1991 until 1996. He is called the **"Father of Indian Economic Reforms"** by many.
